description: This PHP class, UndefinedVardefRule, is a utility for refining metadata rules in SuiteCRM. It extends BaseRule and provides a method to parse and clean panel data structures by clearing empty 'name' fields.

classes.name: UndefinedVardefRule
classes.description: A utility class for handling undefined variable definitions in metadata panels, extending BaseRule.

methods.name: parsePanels
methods.description: Iterates through panels and rows to clear the 'name' field if it is an empty string or unset, returning the modified panels.
